summary: Gain essential skills in government contracts and procurement regulations with our expert-led training course. Sign up now to stay ahead in your field.
lede: Government procurement and contracting training is for procurement, supply chain, finance, and project professionals who make and explain purchasing decisions. It covers assessing needs, planning purchases, selecting and justifying procurement methods, and developing clear solicitation and evaluation criteria. Participants also practice documenting bid reviews and award decisions, managing contract terms and performance, and maintaining procurement records for audits and reviews.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals engaged in procurement and supply chain management across diverse sectors, who need to ensure legal, competitive, and transparent purchasing while delivering results.
modules: Foundations of Public Procurement and Government Contracting
Solicitation Documents That Stand Up to Scrutiny
Bid Receipt, Opening, and Compliance Checks
Contract Formation and Key Contract Clauses
Value for Money, Sustainability, and Responsible Procurement
prerequisites: No specific prerequisites. However, a basic understanding of procurement processes is beneficial.
